WITH route3 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-95.900075 36.030706, -95.899971 36.030928, -95.900035 36.031155, -95.900026 36.031289)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
route4 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-121.362019 42.541572, -121.362463 42.541672, -121.3635 42.541853, -121.364141 42.542136)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip3 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route3 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
dem_clip4 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route4 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT 1 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route3 r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route4 r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    ST_StartPoint(seg)         AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)           AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography)  AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.route_id,
    e.seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p1)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p1) END AS z1,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p2)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p2) END AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip3 dc3, dem_clip4 dc4
),
grades AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM grades
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY route_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN a1.g >= a2.g THEN 'South 69th East Place' ELSE 'Rich Way' END AS answer_name,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a1.g)) AS slope_deg_3,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a2.g)) AS slope_deg_4
FROM avg_grade a1
JOIN avg_grade a2
  ON a1.route_id = 1 AND a2.route_id = 2
WHERE a1.g IS NOT NULL AND a2.g IS NOT NULL;

),
raster_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    r.id,
    r.geom,
    ST_Avg(ST_Slope(ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, true, r.geom), 1)) AS avg_slope
  FROM route_geoms r
  JOIN public.dem_us ON ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, r.geom)
  GROUP BY r.id, r.geom
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN r1.avg_slope > r2.avg_slope THEN '[3]'
    WHEN r1.avg_slope < r2.avg_slope THEN '[4]'
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS higher_slope_route,
  r1.avg_slope AS slope_route_3,
  r2.avg_slope AS slope_route_4
FROM raster_analysis r1
JOIN raster_analysis r2 ON r1.id = '[3]' AND r2.id = '[4]';
